title: Trade-off invariance for weighted scalarizations in multi-objective optimization
summary: We consider weighted-sum scalarizations for an abstract multi-objective minimization problem defined by the vector-valued map $U\ni u\mapsto \big( f_1(u),\ldots, f_N(u)\big)$, where $U$ is an arbitrary nonempty set and no topology, convexity, compactness, or lower semicontinuity assumption is imposed. Using the open simplex as parameter space for positive weights, we show that the Trade-off Invariance Principle for scalarizations yields a generic uniqueness property in the objective space.
